requirement.description: Simulation coroutine handling issues causing TypeError when 'Delay' and 'Tick' objects are not callable, and issues with async/await expressions involving Tick objects.
requirement.contract: Fix the coroutine execution logic to properly handle Delay and Tick objects so they can be awaited correctly, and ensure that Tick objects can be used appropriately in async contexts without being called directly.

requirement.description: Missing NegEdgeTrigger definition causing NameError in simulator tests.
requirement.contract: Add the missing NegEdgeTrigger class or import to ensure it's available for use in simulator tests.

requirement.description: Function signature mismatches in test benchmarks causing TypeError when processes expect arguments but are called without them.
requirement.contract: Ensure that test bench functions in simulation can be called with the correct signatures, particularly for functions that are expected to be called with context parameters.

requirement.description: Issues with pickling module objects in CRC tests causing TypeError when using ProcessPoolExecutor.
requirement.contract: Fix serialization issues in CRC tests to allow proper pickling of objects during multiprocessing operations.

requirement.description: Logic error in simulator reset behavior causing assertion failure (5 != 4).
requirement.contract: Correct the simulator reset logic to ensure proper timing and state management during reset operations.
